1.title: New! Ask Studio on Mobile, Image Uploads, Research Tab, Insights are the new Analytics
1.author: Creator Insider
1.hook: YouTube Studio rolls out Ask Studio on mobile (iOS/Android) with voice prompts and image uploads, introduces a new Research tab for finding outlier/breakout videos, and rebrands Analytics to Insights with plain-language summaries—keeping Advanced analytics and real-time data intact.

1.title: True Enterprise AI Agents Are Still 5 Years Away | Aghi Marietti
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Kong CEO on enterprise AI spending patterns (Fortune 500s still favor frontier models over open-weight), API connectivity as the actual blocker for end-to-end agents (5-year timeline), and prediction that companies will run dozens of internal models rather than consolidate.

1.title: Companies Will Take Legal Responsibility for AI Agents | Ken Wong
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Ken Wong (Databricks Senior Director PM) explains why organizational context—not model intelligence—is the bottleneck for enterprise AI agents; covers Always On Genie launch, Genie Ontology, governance, and how Databricks uses agents internally.

1.title: Grok Bot: What Changes When You Can Build AI Teammates
1.author: Y Combinator
1.hook: Lauren Tan and Roman Ugarte walk through Grok Bot's architecture: how agents earn access incrementally, bot-to-bot collaboration patterns, automated testing as self-checking for AI code, codebase guardrails to reduce token spend, and the shift from code review bottleneck to direction/goal-setting bottleneck when execution becomes fast and cheap.

2.title: Blood Tests Will Catch Returning Cancer 12 Months Early | Tempus
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Tempus CEO on aggregating 600 petabytes of clinical data across 8,000 hospitals, why general LLMs fail on raw medical data (ECGs, DNA sequences), and the 3–10 year timeline for AI-driven clinical breakthroughs. Personal origin story included.

3.title: Physical AI Will Transform 40% of Global GDP | David Gal
3.author: MTS
3.hook: David Gal (Samsara VP) walks through physical AI in industrial operations—ruggedized cameras at Alaska Airlines, off-corridor shipment detection, and how Samsara's trillion-datapoint dataset powers real-world AI products. Covers market sizing and customer deployment case studies.

4.title: Why Meta and Snap Need XR Glasses to Win Attention | Media Studies
4.author: MTS
4.hook: Analysis of how Meta and Snap are using XR hardware to compete for attention, the shift toward closed "dark forest" networks and niche platforms (Retro, Locket, Yope, etc.), and how AI personalization is fragmenting shared culture rather than creating it.

1.title: Apple Hasn’t Reinvented Itself in 10 Years | Elizabeth Dorman
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Elizabeth Dorman (Era CEO, ex-Apple Vision Pro designer) discusses industrial design history, why tech converged on black rectangles, and predicts AI + 3D printing will shift from smartphones to customizable "couture computing" wearables within 5–10 years.

2.title: Claude Found New Dwarf Planets in Public NASA Data | Will Depue
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Will Depue discusses using Claude to find dwarf planets in public NASA telescope data (resulting in a $100k grant), then pivots to discussing his viral takes on AI displacing human skills in 15–20 years and AI as evolutionary competition.

3.title: How Arc’teryx Became a $2B+ Luxury Brand Without Intending To | WSJ The Economics Of
3.author: The Wall Street Journal
3.hook: Luxury brand case study examining Arc'teryx's $2B+ valuation through technical product design, manufacturing, and the "gorpcore" trend's role in streetwear adoption.
